## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title is a [Conventional Commit](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`feat:`, `fix:`, ...); it becomes the changelog entry.
- [ ] `cargo fmt`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test` pass locally.
- [ ] New behavior has tests, and user-visible changes are documented in `docs/`.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` is untouched (release-plz writes it).
